entries.english_draft:
Tessie: Here's my first tip!

Tessie: When you attack once, the monsters get to attack once. When you take a step, they take a step too.

Tessie: If you don't move, they won't do anything. You have plenty of time to think!

Tessie: Checking your items or changing direction won't make them move, either.

Tessie: And that's tip number one! Good luck, dear. Mwah!{heart}

Tessie: Here's tip number four.

Tessie: When there are lots of monsters, read a Bang scroll. You can defeat them all at once.

Tessie: Use a Seed of growth to level up and make your adventure easier.

Tessie: Wait until a monster is right beside you before drinking a Flame herb. Mind which way you're facing!

Tessie: All this advice comes from things you used to tell me. Try to remember, dear. Mwah!{heart}

entries.japanese:
{unclassified-control:14}＊＊＊　冒険の１０の心得　＊＊＊

{unclassified-control:14}著者　　王様


１　自分とモンスターは順番に動く。
　　あせることなかれ！
２　道具を見たり　向きを変えるのは
　　動作したことにはならん！

３　にげるときは
　　敵のナナメ攻撃に注意せよ！
４　歩いているとHPは回復する。
　　あぶなくなったら　まずにげろ！

５　敵が寝ているか起きているかを
　　たしかめること！
　　すべてのモンスターを
　　たおす必要はない！

６　にげられない時は　ルーラ草をのむ！
　　まどわし草は　モンスターに投げる！
７　薬草や弟切草は　HPが最高のときに
　　のむと　最大HPが少し上がる。

８　いかずちの杖は　必ずあたる！
　　バシルーラの杖は　敵をとばす！
９　メダパニの杖は　フラフラにさせ
　　ラリホーの杖は　相手をねむらせる！

１０　毒で下がった「ちから」は
　　　毒けし草で　もとにもどす！
　　　ちからのたねは　そのあとでのむ！


{unclassified-control:14}おわりじゃ
entries.english_draft:
{center}*** Ten Tips for Adventurers ***

{center}By the King

1. You and the monsters take turns. Do not rush!

2. Checking your items or changing direction does not use up a turn.

3. When fleeing, watch out for enemies attacking diagonally!

4. Walking restores HP. When danger threatens, run away first!

5. Check if monsters are awake or asleep. You needn't defeat them all!

6. Drink a Zoom herb if trapped! Throw Misleader herbs at monsters!

7. At full HP, drinking a Medicinal herb or Super herb raises max HP a little.

8. A Lightning staff never misses! A Bazoom staff sends enemies away!

9. A Fuddle staff confuses your foe. A Snooze staff puts your foe to sleep!

10. Use an Antidotal herb to restore strength lost to poison.

Only then drink a Seed of strength!

{center}That is all.
